derivation: For signs s_p in {+1,-1} with sum_p s_p=0, the ordered sum over distinct p,q of s_p s_q equals -M. Division by M(M-1) gives -1/(M-1). The retired argument multiplied two marginal caps instead.
replacement: Sample labeled cells independently and uniformly, then condition on all cells being distinct. The conditioned law is the uniform ordered injection, so P_perm(E) <= P_iid(E)/P_iid(distinct).
